content: विन्यस् €4 <ab>P.</ab> ²1 To put down, deposit, place; विन्यस्यन्ती भुवि गणनया देहलीदत्तपुष्पैः <ls>Me. 89</ls>; <ls>Bk. 3. 3</ls>. .²2 To fix in or on, direct towards; रामे विन्यस्तमानसाः <ls>Rām.</ls> .²3 To deliver or make over, commit to the care of, entrust; सुतविन्यस्तपत्नीकः <ls>Y. 3. 45</ls>. .²4 To arrange, dispose, adjust.
